recipe.visualDefinition: A full-body portrait of a male musician in traditional country attire holding an acoustic guitar, set against a stark white high-key background with a long horizontal shadow. The composition is anchored by large, bold typography at the bottom, framed by a thin blue border with notched corners.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject positioned in the upper right quadrant balanced by heavy typography at the bottom
Long, soft horizontal shadow connecting the subject to the left edge of the frame
High-contrast relationship between the dark denim/hat and the sterile white environment
Textual hierarchy where the primary name overlaps the secondary title
coreInvariants: High-key white background with no horizon line
Thin blue border with 45-degree notched corners
Full-body standing pose with guitar held at waist height

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Subject is scaled to approximately 60% of vertical height, positioned right of center.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The large, dark blue block-lettering at the bottom center.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the subject's face, follows the guitar neck down to the shadow, then moves across to the bold text at the bottom.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Extensive white space on the left side and top, creating a clean, airy feel.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Pure white background for high-key lighting.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Deep navy blue for the primary typography and denim clothing.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Warm wood tones from the guitar and a single red initial in the secondary text.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High value contrast between the background and the dark clothing/text; low saturation except for the warm wood and red accent.

letterConstructionRules: Primary text uses a heavy, condensed grotesque sans-serif with flat terminals.
Secondary text uses a high-contrast transitional serif with sharp bracketed serifs.
characterSpecificRedesigns: First letter of the secondary title is colored red while the rest is muted taupe/grey.
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: High-contrast pairing of a heavy industrial sans-serif with a delicate, elegant serif.
graphicDevices: Thin blue border with notched corners

preserve: Color distinction of the first letter in the serif line

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the heavy, condensed block feel of the primary name.
Provides the necessary classical serif contrast for the title line.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: A full-body studio photograph of a man in a black cowboy hat, blue denim shirt, and jeans holding an acoustic guitar. The background is pure white. A long, soft shadow extends from his feet horizontally to the left. The lighting is bright and even.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a thin navy blue border with 45-degree notched corners. At the bottom, place large condensed navy blue sans-serif text. Overlap this with a second line of serif text in taupe, making the very first letter of the second line bright red.

verificationChecks: Is the background pure white with a long horizontal shadow?
Does the border have notched corners?
Is the primary text a heavy condensed sans-serif?
Does the secondary serif text overlap the primary text?
Is the first letter of the serif text red?

adjustableVariables: Specific shade of blue for the border and text
Length and softness of the shadow
mustRedesign: Specific artist name and album title
Any logos on the guitar headstock
Specific facial features of the artist
postGenerationChecks: Check that the shadow direction is consistent with the lighting on the subject.
Ensure the notched corners of the border are symmetrical.
Verify the red accent color is only on the first letter of the subtitle.
Confirm the subject is not centered, but slightly to the right.
recipe.reuseFormula: High-key studio portrait + long horizontal shadow + notched border frame + layered condensed sans-serif and classical serif typography.
